items.label: Fund report automation
items.summary: Produces regulated fund documents from a sample PDF and finished data, under the analyst's definition.

fields.problem: Fund documents are produced by hand from spreadsheets, late and inconsistently.
fields.vision: Every fund document produced from its definition, on schedule, reproducible, in both languages.

items.quote: Every fund document produced from its definition, on schedule, reproducible, in both languages.

items.label: Report analyst

fields.need: define a report type once and trust what is produced from it

items.quote: The analyst defines the report type once and verifies its mapping.

items.label: Documents produced from a verified definition

fields.promise: what the document shows is what the analyst defined and verified
fields.differentiator: the definition is the product, not the template

items.quote: The definition is the product, not the template.

items.label: Fund Profile (Balanced)
items.summary: The monthly profile of the balanced fund: identity, performance, allocation, disclaimers.

fields.purpose: Give the client the fund's monthly profile in one page.

items.quote: The fund profile is produced monthly, in English and French, as PDF.

items.label: Produce the fund profile monthly, in English and French, as PDF
items.quote: The fund profile is produced monthly, in English and French, as PDF.

items.label: Read every value from a finished column of the report's table; never compute
items.quote: The product reads finished columns; it never computes.

items.label: Keep every accepted revision of a report type's definition, with who and why
items.quote: Every accepted revision is kept, with who accepted it and why.

items.label: Refuse a production release while a field is unmapped
items.quote: A production release is refused while a field is unmapped.

items.label: Every fund profile carries the regulatory disclaimer, signed off by compliance
items.quote: Compliance signs off every published document.
